packaged_program_checks.name: Actual backend identifies itself and demo data is isolated
Native title controls and renderer isolation
Actual static assets and settings render inside Electron
Crop cancel closes immediately without adopting or changing the draft
Escape dismisses the crop and reopening restores its initial selection
Cancel works even when the original page image fails to load
Picture checks are explicit, retryable and bound to the selected display side
Explicit adoption submits exactly one crop and preserves the source card
Bundled setup pairs an isolated add-on or blocks updates while Anki is running
Packaged backend serves APKG and media ZIP for a selected document
The native APKG download button writes a complete file into an isolated destination
Viewing saved cards from a cancelled task refreshes and focuses the packaged result list
Packaged card and practice filters preserve the answer draft and selected lecture
A second desktop instance exits without opening another window
Frozen PDF renderer and bundled OCR work without downloading models
Packaged original-page crops reach a local vision API without an extra interpreter
Native workbench practice follows the selected lecture and blocks unsaved edits
Packaged math preview uses local fonts and preserves LaTeX editor source
Packaged deletion supports cancel, single removal and scoped clearing
Only the spawned backend closes with the native shell
